+# these identities separate even where a monolithic module currently belongs
+# to more than one layer: overlap is conservative, while separate hashes let a
+# policy-only module change re-evaluate sealed raw logs without pretending the
+# runtime, stimulus, or capture producer changed.

+    "tools/deterministic_qualification/artifacts.py",

+    "tools/deterministic_qualification/sandboxie_pair.py",
+)
+
+ONLINE_STIMULUS_SPEC_PATHS = (
+    "tools/deterministic_qualification/observer_pair.py",
+    "tools/deterministic_qualification/paired_online.py",
+    "tools/replay_qualification_mod/OnlineRoomAutomation.cpp",
+    "tools/replay_qualification_mod/OnlineRoomAutomation.hpp",
+    "tools/replay_qualification_mod/ReplayQualificationMod.cpp",
+)

@@ -321,3 +352,32 @@ def capture_harness_sha256(root: Path) -> str:
 def offline_evaluator_sha256(root: Path) -> str:
     """Hash the current policy/composition layer independently of capture."""
     return _named_files_sha256(root, OFFLINE_EVALUATOR_PATHS)
+
+
+def online_capture_harness_sha256(root: Path) -> str:
+    """Hash code which launches, captures, and seals paired online evidence."""
+    return _named_files_sha256(root, ONLINE_CAPTURE_HARNESS_PATHS)
+
+
+def online_stimulus_spec_sha256(root: Path) -> str:
+    """Hash the exact paired match/fault/correction stimulus producer."""
+    return _named_files_sha256(root, ONLINE_STIMULUS_SPEC_PATHS)
+
+
+def online_evaluator_sha256(root: Path) -> str:
+    """Hash online policy independently from runtime and external tooling."""
+    return _named_files_sha256(root, ONLINE_EVALUATOR_PATHS)
+
+
+def external_tool_identity(path: Path | None) -> dict[str, object] | None:
+    """Bind an optional reviewed external impairment tool by exact bytes."""
+    if path is None:
+        return None
+    resolved = path.resolve()
+    if not resolved.is_file():
+        raise FileNotFoundError(f"external tool not found: {resolved}")
+    return {
+        "path": str(resolved),
+        "size": resolved.stat().st_size,
+        "sha256": sha256_file(resolved),
+    }

+def _raise_if_match_ended(

+) -> None:
+    """Fail as soon as status 7 makes the named active-match gates impossible."""
